permissions.items.view: Browse, search and export the item master, its history, vacancies and ERP status
permissions.items.create: Create new item codes (resolve, ingest, commit) and add item aliases
permissions.items.edit: Edit existing items, spec values and labels; rename; revert an item to an earlier version
permissions.taxonomy.manage: Add heads, sub-heads and groups; move, merge or delete groups; map and classify ERP items
permissions.erp.push: Push items, specs and vendors to ERPNext
permissions.erp.sync: Run the ERPNext sync and the reconcile
permissions.settings.manage: Change Item Code Studio settings, including LLM provider and keys

roles.name: Associate
roles.description: Looks up item codes and raises new ones. Cannot change existing items or the taxonomy.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Everything an associate can do, plus edit items, restructure the taxonomy and push or sync with ERPNext.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Everything a manager can do, plus Item Code Studio settings and LLM keys.
